sketch:
Observe: split view — SVG mass-spring schematic left (mass m on
spring k, either horizontal or vertical), SVG polyline x(t) graph
right. Student sets m, k, x₀; ticker (with per-exercise time-scale)
drives the SHM x(t) = Xₘ·cos(ω₀t + φ) with ω₀ = √(k/m), T₀ =
2π·√(m/k). HUD reads T₀. Experiment: 3 seeded target curves
(T*, Xₘ*); student tunes m, k, x₀ to overlay. Evaluate: live curve
hidden, only target curve; student submits and curves overlay for
feedback. Wrinkle: undamped closed-form; no Euler.
